title: Barbarian
description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage to withstand devastating damage.

title: Bard
description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation, bolstering allies with restorative tunes.

title: Cleric
description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power, smiting foes and healing allies.

title: Druid
description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding elemental powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

title: Fighter
description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor, renowned for Second Wind endurance.

title: Monk
description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the energy of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

title: Paladin
description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath, channeling radiant smites and laying hands to heal.

title: Ranger
description: A warrior of the wilderness who combats threats on the edges of civilization with bows and blades.

title: Rogue
description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and deliver lethal sneak attacks.

title: Sorcerer
description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline, shaping spells through Metamagic.

title: Warlock
description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an otherworldly patron, blasting foes with eldritch energy.

title: Wizard
description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating reality through rigorous study, grimoires, and arcane formulae.
